critical_code_review_comments: ActivitiesPage.js line 139 used <SelectItem value="">All categories</SelectItem> — Radix has explicitly disallowed empty strings since v1.x because it conflicts with placeholder semantics. This is a recurring class of bug; consider an eslint rule or codemod to flag SelectItem value="".

rca_of_the_issue: Critical bug: ActivitiesPage.js line 139 had `<SelectItem value="">All categories</SelectItem>`. Radix UI Select disallows empty-string item values because they conflict with the placeholder/clear semantics, throwing 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string' at React render time. This crashed the entire /activities page (CRA error overlay), making the new feature fully unusable. Reproduction: navigate to /activities while authenticated → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay, no page testids render. Mitigation applied: replaced empty-string value with 'all' sentinel, set initial state to 'all', and updated fetchActivities() to skip the category filter when category==='all'. Verified: page now renders cleanly, all 12 modal testids appear, create flow end-to-end produces a valid activity card with toast '+50 pts'.
